message: Add Android extension build, iOS Safari userscript scanner, and adaptive install guide (v1.8.22)
changelog: Unified Swiss Grid Design System (docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md, mobile-web/index.html, src/popup/styles/, src/mobile/styles/, src/userscript/overlayUi.ts, src/content/content.css): Updated DESIGN_SYSTEM.md from the landing page tokens and unified light/dark surfaces (--bg, --bg-alt, --surface, --surface-elevated, --surface-hover), borders (#e2e8f0 / #cbd5e1 light, #2c2c36 / #3f3f4c dark), typography stacks (Inter Tight, Inter, --font-mono), and primary accent tokens (#18181b / #f4f4f6) across Landing Page, Extension, Companion PWA, Blackboard floating pill, and Safari Userscript overlay.

Landing Page Scroll Reveal Animations (mobile-web/index.html, mobile-web/landing-motion.js): Added IntersectionObserver scroll-reveal choreography (bb-reveal / is-in) with subtle staggered entrances for feature grids, workbench panels, device preview cards, adaptive install steps, FAQs, and closing panels while respecting prefers-reduced-motion.
